Hit Steiner: Cure-All, Fire Sword + attack

turns: Steiner Fire Sword + Vivi double Fire

grotto_mages2.name: Black Mages (Grotto 2)

burmecia_mages.name: Black Mages (Burmecia)
turns: ATB-wait if a mage goes first

beatrix1.name: Beatrix 1

ralvurahva.name: Ralvurahva

hilgigars.name: Hilgigars

soulcage.name: Soulcage
turns: Eiko: Life, or throw an Elixir
Zidane must be alive (Ability Up AP)
Zidane Lv 15: don't heal it while LV5 Death is queued

amarant.name: Amarant
turns: He acts twice per Zidane turn: watch HP
Jumping: the spot near the left side always hits

ark.name: Ark
turns: Round 3: Amarant throws the Diamond Sword

valia_pira.name: Valia Pira
turns: Vivi: Water-all on your own party
Open a submenu during Vivi's animation

red_dragons.name: Red Dragons
turns: Vivi Blizzaga + Steiner attack per dragon
Zidane: Soul Blade the other one (Confuse)
KO Amarant and Vivi before the last hit

meltigemini.name: Meltigemini
turns: Solo at the end: Elixir if needed

taharka.name: Taharka
turns: Steiner: Attack (Flame Saber Heat ends it)

Freya heals; Zidane, Freya, Steiner must live

earth_guardian.name: Earth Guardian
turns: Quina: Defend (Elixir Zidane if he's in danger)
Eat once it's at 5,189 HP or less (15,567 dealt)

amdusias.name: Amdusias
turns: Wait: Bio, then it flies up
Amarant: Throw Wing Edge (Freya attacks if needed)
Revive Freya or Amarant if KO'd

abadon.name: Abadon
turns: Steiner hurt: he attacks himself (Coral Ring)

shell_dragon.name: Shell Dragon
turns: Get Zidane to yellow HP: Garnet joins and heals
KO Garnet before the end (LV5 Death later)

silver_dragon.name: Silver Dragon
turns: Amarant can throw a Wing Edge

garland.name: Garland
turns: Revive the KO'd (they come back in yellow)

kuja_d3.name: Kuja
turns: No AP: skip revives near the end

nova_dragon.name: Nova Dragon
turns: Opens Tidal Wave/Aerial Slash: Wing Edge, Freya Luna
Opens Shockwave or Telekinesis: lean on Steiner's Charge!
Attack carefully: it counters attacks (not Charge!)

maliris.name: Maliris
turns: No Auto-Life left: Freya Jumps before the last hit

kraken.name: Kraken
turns: Freya + Steiner: the other (Freya goes last)
Then: Zidane attack, Steiner Charge!, Amarant attack
Finish with Charge! or one attack

lich.name: Lich
turns: Phoenix Down Freya before a Charge!

deathguise.name: Deathguise
turns: Revive Amarant only while it's closed

trance_kuja.name: Trance Kuja
turns: One attack each: Zidane, Freya, Amarant
Last hit: a normal attack is fine

necron.name: Necron
turns: Freya: Phoenix Down Steiner, then Zidane
Hold Steiner's menu until Zidane is done, Charge!
necron.if_wrong: Protect: no revives, Jump again after the 3rd Shockwave.
